text: CSV export times out for any report over 50k rows. Our renewal is on November 2 and our CFO is asking why this has been broken for three weeks. If it is not fixed by Friday we will not renew.
Exports keep failing with a timeout error when we pull the quarterly usage report. Our finance team is blocked on month-end close until this works.
The CSV export is really slow for our biggest workspace and sometimes just spins forever. Not a showstopper, but it is annoying for the team.
Score 4. Exports time out on large datasets, so we have started writing our own scripts against the API instead.
SAML SSO login fails for about half of our users with an invalid assertion error. Our 400 clinicians are blocked from logging in and we go live with the new ward rollout on Monday October 26.
Our security team found that SSO sessions stay active after logout. This has to be fixed before our SOC 2 audit starts on October 30. Please escalate to your engineering lead.
Okta login keeps looping back to the sign-in page for a few of our admins. The workaround is to use an incognito window.
Call with their ops lead. The Salesforce sync dropped about 2,000 account updates last week and nobody noticed. If we cannot show a root cause by October 23 they will start evaluating a competitor.
The Salesforce integration stopped syncing new contacts after your update on the 10th. We need a fix before our sales kickoff on October 28.
We connected Salesforce last week and it works, though the field mapping screen is confusing. It would help to map custom objects too.
Dashboards take 30 seconds or more to load on Monday mornings. Our execs complain about it every week and I am frustrated explaining it.
Score 5. The product is powerful but the main dashboard is painfully slow.
Dashboard widgets render blank for our EMEA users in the morning and only fill in after a manual refresh.
We were charged twice for the September invoice, two charges of $12,400. Please refund the duplicate because our accounts payable team closes the books on October 21.
The invoice PDF shows our old billing address. Could someone update it so the next invoice is correct?
Procurement asked whether we can move from monthly to annual billing with a discount. They would like a quote.
Support took four days to reply to our ticket about audit logs. This is the third slow response this quarter and the team is losing patience.
QBR prep call. Our champion said leadership is comparing us with a competitor and the decision will be made before their renewal on November 15.
Score 3. The audit log export is missing fields we need for compliance, and support is slow.
Following up on our SSO ticket. Our CIO will escalate to your CEO tomorrow if we do not have an ETA. Staff cannot be onboarded until they can log in.
The API rate limit of 100 requests per minute is too low for our nightly sync. We hit 429 errors all the time. Can you raise it?
Love the new saved views feature. It saves our team hours every week.
Their product lead wants SCIM user provisioning because they are rolling out to 12 new regions and manual user setup will not scale.
Score 6. Good reporting, but we want a way to schedule exports to email every Monday.
Thanks for the quick help last week. The onboarding walkthrough for our new analysts was clear and they were productive on day one.
Is there a way to bulk-edit tags on more than 100 records? Right now we do it one at a time.
Would be great to get dark mode in the web app. A few of our analysts work late.
Score 7. Setup took longer than expected but support walked us through it.
Can you add webhooks for new alerts? We would like to push them into our own pager tool.
Their CTO asked about SOC 2 and data residency in the EU. He said it will matter when they sign the next big customer.
Search results ignore filters after the last release. We reported this twice and had no answer.
The mobile app logs our nurses out every few minutes, which is making shift handovers painful.
Score 4. The platform fits our workflow, but logins have been unreliable since the last update.
Following up on the export ticket. Any news? We have not heard back since Tuesday.
Our rep says the Salesforce sync issue is known. Is there a public status page we can check?
Follow-up: the Salesforce contact sync is still down and now our reps are entering leads by hand. This is costing us deals.
Sharing positive news: the new permissions model is exactly what our admins asked for.
Score 9. Easy to set up and the team picked it up quickly.
Anyone know how to reset a user's two-factor device? The docs link is a 404.
Intro with their new VP of Ops. Happy overall, asked about the roadmap for a custom report builder and pricing for extra seats.
